column2: His tangential remarks about his vacation drifted away from the budget topic and wasted ten minutes.
column3: 他關於假期的離題言論偏離了預算議題，浪費了十分鐘。
column5: tangent 切線只碰圓一點就飛出去，話題擦邊就跑

column2: The judge ruled the question irrelevant, since the witness's hobbies had nothing to do with the crime.
column3: 法官裁定該問題無關，因為證人的嗜好與犯罪毫無關聯。
column5: ir 不 + relevant 有關，跟主題沒有關係

column2: Doctors sent the patient to a salubrious mountain village, where the clear air helped her recover.
column3: 醫生把病人送到有益健康的山村，那裡的清新空氣幫助她康復。
column5: 「三鹿不累」，山間空氣好，人也舒服

column2: The failed audition was a salutary lesson, teaching the young singer to practice far more.
column3: 試鏡失敗是一堂有益的教訓，教那位年輕歌手多加練習。
column5: salut 敬禮致意，像健康祝福 salute

column2: Grandfather loved the wholesome food from his garden, which kept the whole family strong and healthy.
column3: 爺爺愛吃自家花園種的健康食物，讓全家人都強壯又健康。
column5: whole 完整 + some，整顆完整的好食物

column2: Years of breathing factory smoke had a deleterious effect on the villagers' lungs.
column3: 多年吸入工廠煙霧對村民的肺部有害。
column5: delete 刪除，把健康一步步刪掉

column2: The pernicious rumor spread through town and gradually destroyed the baker's reputation.
column3: 那個有害的謠言傳遍全鎮，逐漸毀掉了麵包師的名聲。
column5: per 徹底 + nic 傷害，一路把人弄壞

column2: Workers wore masks to avoid breathing the noxious fumes drifting from the chemical plant.
column3: 工人戴上口罩，避免吸入從化工廠飄來的有毒氣體。
column5: nox 像 knocks，毒氣來敲你的鼻子

column2: Ancient tales warned of the baneful power of a cursed ring that brought ruin to every owner.
column3: 古老的傳說警告人們一枚受詛咒戒指的禍害力量，讓每位主人都走向毀滅。
column5: bane 禍根，像 ban 禁止，壞東西要禁掉

column2: The insidious disease spread silently for months before any symptoms appeared.
column3: 那種潛伏性疾病在任何症狀出現前，默默擴散了好幾個月。
column5: in 裡面 + sid 坐，悄悄坐在你身體裡

column2: The ingenuous child told the stranger exactly where the family kept its spare key.
column3: 那個天真的孩子坦率地告訴陌生人家裡備用鑰匙放在哪裡。
column5: in 內 + genu 天生，內心天生沒有心機

column2: Her artless charm, free of any trace of calculation, won the hearts of the audience.
column3: 她毫不造作的魅力沒有任何算計的痕跡，贏得了觀眾的心。
column5: less 沒有 + art 技巧，沒有裝飾的真誠

column2: His disingenuous apology, offered only after the scandal broke, convinced nobody of his regret.
column3: 他那只在醜聞爆發後才提出的不誠懇道歉，沒有讓人相信他真的後悔。
column5: dis 不 + ingenuous 坦率，假裝老實

column2: The cunning fox tricked the farmer by pretending to be hurt, then slipped away with the hen.
column3: 狡猾的狐狸假裝受傷來欺騙農夫，然後帶著母雞溜走。
column5: 「砍你」不是砍，是用小聰明騙你上當

column2: With quiet guile, the fox lured the rabbit out of its burrow by pretending to be lost.
column3: 狐狸用悄悄的狡詐，假裝迷路，把兔子引出洞穴。
column5: guile 唸起來像 guy 家，是詭計多端的傢伙

column2: Her duplicity was exposed when colleagues discovered she had been praising the rival firm in secret.
column3: 同事發現她暗中稱讚對手公司時，她的表裡不一被揭穿了。
column4: exposed duplicity (被揭穿的口是心非)
column5: duo 兩個 + plic 摺，兩副面孔

column2: Through legal chicanery, the landlord avoided repaying the deposit and left the tenants with nothing.
column3: 房東用法律詭計避免退還押金，讓房客一無所有。
column5: 「吸砍你」用繞圈子的把戲討便宜

column2: The captain's perfidy shocked the crew, for he had secretly sold the ship's map to the enemy.
column3: 船長的背信棄義震驚了船員，因為他暗中把航海圖賣給敵人。
column4: an act of perfidy (背信棄義的行為)
column5: per 穿過 + fid 信任，信任被穿破

column2: Brutus's treachery toward Caesar remains one of the most famous betrayals in all of literature.
column3: 布魯圖斯對凱撒的背叛是整個文學史上最著名的背叛之一。
column4: an act of treachery (背叛行為)
column5: trea 像 trick 騙 + chery，朋友變成對手

column2: The reporter checked three sources to confirm the veracity of the shocking story before publishing it.
column3: 記者在刊登前查證三個消息來源，以確認這則驚人報導的真實性。
column5: ver 真 + city 城，真理之城，句句屬實

column2: With rare candor, the coach admitted that his own strategy had caused the team's defeat.
column3: 教練以罕見的坦率承認，是自己的策略造成了球隊的失敗。
column5: candle 蠟燭點亮，一切透明坦白

column2: Known for his probity, the old clerk returned every misplaced coin to its rightful owner.
column3: 這位老職員以廉潔正直聞名，把每一枚放錯的硬幣都還給合法的主人。
column5: probe 探測，正直的人經得起檢查

column2: The judge's moral rectitude was beyond question, and not even bribes could change her ruling.
column3: 法官的道德正直無庸置疑，連賄賂也無法改變她的裁決。
column5: rect 直 + itude 狀態，直直的、不彎曲

column2: The memoir's mendacity became clear when historians found no record of the battles it described.
column3: 歷史學家找不到回憶錄所述戰役的任何紀錄時，其虛假便顯而易見。
column5: mend 修補，總在補謊言的洞

column2: The mendacious witness changed his story three times, and the jury stopped believing a word of it.
column3: 那位說謊的證人三度改變說法，陪審團不再相信他說的任何一句話。
column5: mend 修補，總要修補的謊話

column2: An apocryphal story claims Newton discovered gravity when an apple fell on his head.
column3: 一則真偽存疑的故事說牛頓因蘋果砸到頭而發現了重力。
column5: apo 遠離 + cryph 隱藏，來源藏起來無法證實

column2: The fallacious argument assumed that because two events occurred together, one must have caused the other.
column3: 那個謬誤論點假設兩件事同時發生，就必定有一件造成另一件。
column5: fall 跌倒，推理走一步就絆倒

column2: The lecturer's soporific drone made half the class nod off before the first break.
column3: 講師催眠般的單調聲音讓半數學生在第一次休息前就打起瞌睡。
column5: sop 像 sleep，聽了想睡的聲音

column2: After the heavy lunch, the somnolent cat stretched on the windowsill and barely blinked all afternoon.
column3: 吃完豐盛午餐後，昏昏欲睡的貓在窗台上伸懶腰，整個下午幾乎沒眨眼。
column5: som 睡眠，somnia 是失眠 insomnia 的睡

column2: Feeling lethargic after the flu, she could barely climb the stairs to her room.
column3: 流感後覺得無精打采，她幾乎爬不上樓回房間。
column5: Lethe 是遺忘之河，喝了就想睡

column2: The torpid lizard lay motionless on the cold rock until the morning sun warmed it.
column3: 那隻遲鈍的蜥蜴一動不動地躺在冷岩石上，直到晨光溫暖了它。
column5: torpedo 魚雷也叫電鰩，會讓人麻木

column2: The indolent heir spent his days napping in a hammock while the farm slowly fell into ruin.
column3: 那位怠惰的繼承人整天躺在吊床上打盹，農場則漸漸荒廢。
column5: in 不 + dol 痛，連痛都不想，不想動

column2: The sluggish economy recovered so slowly that many families waited years for new jobs.
column3: 遲緩的經濟復甦得很慢，許多家庭等了數年才找到新工作。
column5: slug 蛞蝓慢吞吞，爬得很慢

column2: Long hours in the heat enervated the hikers, who sat down in the shade too tired to speak.
column3: 在高溫下走了很久使健行者疲憊無力，他們坐在樹蔭下累得說不出話。
column5: e 出 + nerve 神經力氣，把力氣抽光

column2: A long illness had debilitated the old sailor, leaving him too weak to lift the anchor.
column3: 長期疾病使老水手變得虛弱，他連錨都舉不起來。
column5: de 去掉 + abil 能力，把能力拿走

column2: A brisk morning swim invigorated the weary travelers, and soon they were ready to climb again.
column3: 清晨活力十足的游泳振奮了疲憊的旅人，不久他們又準備好攀爬。
column5: in 使 + vigor 活力，給你元氣

column2: The coach's fiery speech galvanized the discouraged players into one last desperate comeback.
column3: 教練熱烈的演說激勵了垂頭喪氣的球員，奮力作最後一次逆轉。
column4: galvanize into action (激勵採取行動)
column5: Galvani 用電讓青蛙腿跳起來，被電到就動

column2: Her warm laughter animated the dull dinner, and soon everyone at the table was telling stories.
column3: 她溫暖的笑聲讓沉悶的晚餐活絡起來，不久同桌的人都開始說故事。
column5: anima 生命，像 animal 有生命會動

column2: The ebullient host greeted every guest with a hug and filled the evening with bright, bubbling chatter.
column3: 興致高昂的主人擁抱每位客人，用明亮、滔滔不絕的談笑填滿整個夜晚。
column5: e 出 + bull 泡泡，快樂冒泡泡

column2: The exuberant puppy leapt about the garden, wagging its tail at every passing bee.
column3: 那隻活力四射的小狗在花園裡跳來跳去，對每隻飛過的蜜蜂搖尾巴。
column5: ex 出 + uber 豐盛，快樂多到溢出來
